about: Lists interview-rules holds by input template (engine/src/interview-rules.ts), each with a reason, until the gate wave fixes its cause. early_completion: inputs left reachable and unanswered when the interview reports a return complete. order_dependent_reach: inputs reachable at an incomplete state of a complete return that its bank-order walk never asks (an order-dependent leak). walked_unused: inputs the bank-order walk asks that the complete return's evaluation does not read (a pruning opportunity; reports/2025/interview_pruning.md). A template not listed fails the check, and a listed template no longer seen fails until it is removed, so each list may only shrink. Most entries are conjunctions to rewrite as nested choose.

early_completion.sa.elect_itemize: on generated.71 in a random order; either answer leaves the status and every target value as they are (probed); held until the T-276 family rewrites (goal-1 lane T3); found by the check widened under BUG-0602 (complete generated returns selected, one-entry minimal returns)
early_completion.dependent.disabled: on generated.375 in a random order; lane T2's four-seed sweep found the same template and probed it (s21.149): either answer leaves the status and every target value as they are; found by interview-rules at integration B1 of the goal-1 round; cause traced by lane b1-mutB (docs/provisional/lanes/b1-mutB.md): dependent.disabled is read by dependent.qc_age_younger, qc_age_19 and qc_age_student, the age branches of the qualifying-child test; on a single return with a household member aged 15 (dep_c, not a qualifying child by relationship) a random order can complete the return while those branches still read it ahead; either answer leaves the status and every target value as they are (lane T2's probe, s21.149, and this witness, seed 11219 + 2 x 100003). The goal-1 lanes changed none of these lines (diffed against g1-base b3dc1c0b); the return is witnessed now because the merged generator (lane T2) and data moved the seeded sample. Held until the gate wave rewrites the test as a choose chain.

order_dependent_reach.ny_it201.ask.moved_out: on ny.generated.933, until ny_it201.ask.moved_in was answered; found by interview-rules at integration B1 of the goal-1 round; cause traced by lane b1-mutB (docs/provisional/lanes/b1-mutB.md): ny_it201.moved is any[ny_it201.ask.moved_in true, ny_it201.ask.moved_out true]; a Yes to moved_in decides it, so moved_out, asked after it in bank order (seq 41, 42), is reached first only in an order that asks moved_out before moved_in. Seq cannot fix an order the check draws at random; a gate (moved_out asked only after a No to moved_in) would. The goal-1 lanes changed none of these lines (diffed against g1-base b3dc1c0b); the return is witnessed now because the merged New York generator and data moved the seeded sample. Held until the gate wave rewrites the test as a choose chain.

walked_unused.dependent.born_died: asked in bank order and unread by the complete return on ny.generated.1130 (a pruning opportunity, reports/2025/interview_pruning.md); found by interview-rules at integration B1 of the goal-1 round; cause traced by lane b1-mutB (docs/provisional/lanes/b1-mutB.md): lane g1-f9's T-304 item 1 chain. On a single return with a dependent listed and household.home_cost Yes, household.hoh_missed_person counts household.test2_lived_persons, whose filter reads dependent.hoh_test2_lived; that line's two all-tests read on past an unknown dependent.claimed and dependent.qualifying_child into dependent.hoh_lived_half (dependent.lived_half: months, and kidnapped through its refusal gate; dependent.hoh_part_year: born_died, then placed), so the bank-order walk asks them before the answers that decide the person is neither claimed nor a qualifying child. With home_cost No on the same inputs (checked) none of them is asked. Before the round dependent.hoh_test2_lived was read only on the head of household path (dependent.hoh_test2, and dependent.hoh_absence through household.hoh_absence, under household.hoh_eligible, which household.hoh_fails reads only for status hoh). Fix (not made here: new choose lines in dependent.yaml, an expression change with its mutation, class M and render work): read dependent.hoh_lived_half only after dependent.claimed, or dependent.qualifying_child, is known true. Witness ny.generated.1130 (a child of 14, 6 months, gross income too high to be claimed).
